content.text: Digital creators are facing severe restrictions on platforms like Stripe and PayPal, limiting their ability to monetize their work effectively. This guide empowers you to deploy a digital store on [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/cloudflare-r2-digital-product-storage-delivery-explained-digital-10|COREMERCH guide to cloudflare]] Pages for free, utilizing the sovereign infrastructure model that ensures you have [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/complete-deep-dive-digital-product-stores-kyc-payments-3|The Complete]]-deep-dive-github-pages-free-digital-product-2|complete]] ownership and control. With COREMERCH’s Edge Stack, you can accept crypto payments seamlessly without the hurdles of traditional payment systems. In just 48 hours, you can set up a fully operational digital commerce stack that allows you to thrive in an environment where conventional platforms have failed you.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Many digital creators in regions like Nigeria, Ghana, and Venezuela have experienced the frustration of not being able to access conventional payment platforms. COREMERCH’s infrastructure circumvents these issues by providing a stack that uses decentralized payment systems, ensuring your store remains operational regardless of the constraints imposed by traditional financial services. This architecture allows you to own your data and products without relying on third-party platforms that could restrict your access at any moment.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying your digital store, gather your assets: products to sell, images, descriptions, and any marketing materials. Ensure you have a Cloudflare account for hosting your site and a NOWPayments account to handle cryptocurrency transactions. Familiarize yourself with Google Apps Script for backend logic setup. This preparation will streamline your deployment process, whether you choose Stack 01 or Stack 02, and ensure you hit the ground running.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

For Stack 02, start by deploying Cloudflare Workers for backend logic. Integrate NOWPayments for automatic crypto payment processing, ensuring you can accept over 300 cryptocurrencies with minimal fees. Set up Supabase for order management, allowing you to track sales and customer data securely. Configure your delivery system using Cloudflare R2 or Google Drive for product file storage, guaranteeing that your customers receive their purchases instantly upon payment confirmation.
Infrastructure sovereignty means you own your digital store, free from third-party limitations.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your store is set up, perform end-to-end testing to ensure everything functions as expected. After confirming that your payment processing and delivery mechanisms are operational, promote your store to your audience. Share your store link widely, and monitor the first transactions closely to address any issues as they arise. The moment your first customer completes a purchase, your systems will prove their reliability and effectiveness.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After successfully processing transactions, focus on scaling your digital store. Utilize the Complete Builder Kit to access additional templates and blueprints that can enhance your product offerings. Analyze customer feedback and sales data to identify trends and adjust your marketing strategy accordingly. As your store grows, ensure that your infrastructure can handle increased traffic by optimizing your Cloudflare settings and potentially expanding your product range.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

To build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free, you need to deploy on Cloudflare Pages using a sovereign stack like COREMERCH's Edge Stack. This setup allows you to bypass traditional payment restrictions and maintain full control over your store's infrastructure, ensuring a seamless experience for both you and your customers.
Crypto payments eliminate the need for traditional banking systems, empowering creators.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

This guide connects directly to your search for effective deployment strategies. For those looking to access all necessary resources, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197) available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html, which provides essential blueprints and templates for building your sovereign digital commerce stack.
Your Deployment Checklist

Read the Sovereign Blueprint before you start configuring anything — understanding the complete architecture before touching any settings prevents the most common configuration mistakes. Create all required accounts first: NOWPayments, Cloudflare or GitHub, Supabase or Google account, Resend or Gmail. Then configure the backend with all credentials before deploying it. Then deploy the backend and confirm the endpoint is live. Then configure NOWPayments with the endpoint URL. Then build and deploy the storefront. Then configure your custom domain if using one. Then run the mainnet test. Then check the order database. Then — and only then — share the URL. The sequence is not arbitrary. Each step depends on the previous one.
Frequently Asked Questions
How long does it take to deploy Stack 01?
Deploying Stack 01 takes approximately 4-6 hours following the Sovereign Blueprint. This stack provides a rapid solution for creators needing immediate access to a digital store.
What are the main advantages of Stack 02 over Stack 01?

Stack 02 offers enhanced capabilities, including Cloudflare Workers for backend logic and Supabase for order management. It is fully end-to-end tested by COREMERCH in 48 hours, providing a more robust infrastructure.
Can I use Stack 01 for hosting my digital products?
Yes, Stack 01 utilizes GitHub Pages for hosting your digital products. It is a cost-effective solution that provides a reliable platform for digital creators.
What cryptocurrencies can I accept with NOWPayments?
NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, making it easy to accept a wide range of digital currencies for your products. This flexibility enhances your store’s payment options.
Is there ongoing support after deployment?
Yes, both stacks come with a 30-day support period after deployment. This ensures you have assistance as you navigate the initial stages of running your digital store.
COREMERCH stacks are designed for speed and efficiency, ensuring quick deployment and high reliability.
